About Immutable

Immutable is a gaming-focused ecosystem that includes Immutable zkEVM. IMX pays fees and is used for staking and governance.

Where this IMX price comes from

The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (IMX-USD), Binance (IMX/USDT) and Kraken (IMX/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 1.94B IMX (supply last updated October 30, 2026).
